claims.text: Dam Square is the bustling historical center of Amsterdam and is actually located at the original site of the city's first dam on the Amstel River.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Built in approximately 1270, this crucial dam directly inspired the name of the entire city itself.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Over many years, as the dam was gradually built up and expanded, the space eventually became wide enough to serve as a proper town square.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: On one side of the square stands the massive National Monument, a towering white stone pillar revealed on 4 May 1956.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Designed by the architect J.J.P. Oud, this poignant memorial is dedicated to all the innocent victims of World War II.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Every single year on that exact same date, a solemn ceremony is held right here in the square to honour their lasting memory.
claims.subject: self
